# PastePretty

> Paste your data, get beautiful visualizations. Instantly.

PastePretty transforms raw data — JSON, Markdown tables, CSV, PostgreSQL output — into polished, themed visualizations ready for sharing, documentation, or presentations.

## What it does

- Paste any tabular data and get a styled visualization in seconds
- Supports tables, bar charts, line charts, pie charts, scatter plots, heatmaps, treemaps, funnel charts, area charts, stat cards, and comparison cards
- 30+ built-in themes (Vercel, GitHub, Stripe, Linear, Supabase, Tailwind, and more)
- Customizable colors, fonts, backgrounds, border radius, and window frames (macOS / Windows style)
- Export as PNG, JPG, SVG, JSON, CSV, Markdown, or SQL
- Upload custom background images
- Light and dark mode support
- Fully client-side — no data leaves your browser

## Pages

- [Home](https://pastepretty.com/): Tables + bar/line/pie charts
- [Scatter](https://pastepretty.com/scatter): Scatter plots with grouping
- [Heatmap](https://pastepretty.com/heatmap): Color-scaled heatmaps
- [Treemap](https://pastepretty.com/treemap): Hierarchical treemaps
- [Funnel](https://pastepretty.com/funnel): Funnel/conversion charts
- [Area](https://pastepretty.com/area): Area charts
- [Stat Card](https://pastepretty.com/stat-card): Metric/KPI stat cards
- [Comparison](https://pastepretty.com/comparison): Side-by-side comparison cards

## How to use

1. Paste your data (JSON, Markdown table, CSV, or PostgreSQL output)
2. Pick a theme and visualization type
3. Customize colors, fonts, and layout
4. Export as an image or data format

## Tech

Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. All rendering happens client-side using SVG and html-to-image.
